description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: The Steelers D/ST allowed 14 points, 208 passing yards, and 136 rushing yards in the 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: The Steelers' defense did tally an interception, a fumble recovery, and three sacks in the losing effort Sunday. The Steelers' defense will be at home against a strong Bengals' offense in Week 3.
items.title: Steelers D/ST allows 14 points in Week 2 loss

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Chris Boswell connected on 1-of-2 field goals in the Steelers 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Boswell connected on a 56-yard field goal and missed from 57-yards out in the first quarter. There were reports prior to the game that Boswell was struggling with kicks in pregame warmups, but both his miss and connection were from 55+ yards. Boswell and the Steelers will take on the Bengals at home in Week 3.
items.title: Chris Boswell misses a FG attempt in Week 2 loss

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Steelers TE Pat Freiermuth caught 4-of-5 targets for 32 yards and rushed once for two yards in the Steelers 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Freiermuth has logged five targets in both games this season and appears to have built a rapport with Aaron Rodgers. With Michael Pittman dealing with an ankle injury, the veteran tight end could be a solid option heading into a Week 3 matchup with the Bengals.
items.title: Pat Freiermuth hauls in four passes in Week 2

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Steelers WR Germie Bernard caught 4-of-8 targets for 35 yards in the Steelers' 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Bernard saw an increase in playing time with Michael Pittman (ankle) unavailable for Week 2. The rookie wide receiver did have a key drop that lead to a Patriots interception. Bernard will look to build on this performance in Week 3 against the Bengals.
items.title: Germie Bernard leads team in receiving yards in Week 2

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Steelers WR Roman Wilson caught 5-of-6 targets for 28 yards in the Steelers' 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Wilson has now seen six targets in both games this season and should continue to see an increase in usage as long as Michael Pittman is dealing with an ankle injury. Wilson's five receptions lead the team, but the Steelers' passing attack really failed to get anything consistent going. Wilson and the Steelers will take on the Bengals at home in Week 3.
items.title: Roman Wilson hauls in five passes in Week 2 loss

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Steelers WR DK Metcalf caught 4-of-9 targets for 27 yards in a 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Metcalf was shadowed by Patriots DB Christian Gonzalez for the majority of the game, limiting his production and forcing Aaron Rodgers to look elsewhere. Metcalf has lead the team in targets in the first two games, so the target volume is encouraging, fantasy managers are just waiting for it to result in more production. Metcalf and the Steelers will take on the Bengals in Week 3.
items.title: DK Metcalf leads team in targets in Week 2 loss

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Jordan Love completed 16-of-29 pass attempts for 145 yards and two touchdowns in the Packers' 20-17 Week 2 win over the New York Jets.
items.impact: Love continues a solid start to the season as part of a Green Bay offense battling inconsistency early on, throwing two touchdowns in each of the first two games. The quarterback will look for more sizeable success for fantasy managers in a favorable Week 3 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.title: Jordan Love tosses two touchdowns in Week 2 win over Jets

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Christian Watson hauled in four of his team-high 11 targets for 41 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 20-17 Week 2 win over the New York Jets.
items.impact: Watson has been impactful as part of an inconsistent Green Bay offense to begin the season, catching one or more touchdowns on eight or more targets in each of the first two games. The wideout offers fantasy managers one of the few stable options in an underperforming Packer offense ahead of a favorable Week 3 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.title: Christian Watson finds end zone in Week 2 win over Jets

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Steelers RB Rico Dowdle rushed for 22 yards on seven carries and caught both of his targets for 22 yards in the Steelers' 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Dowdle suffered the toe injury in the second quarter but was cleared to return after the half. He was later ruled out with the same injury, so he may have reaggravated it in the second half.  If Dowdle is unable to suit up in Week 3, Jaylen Warren will be the primary running back against the Bengals.
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) finishes with nine touches in Week 2 loss

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: MarShawn Lloyd rushed six times for 20 yards while also hauling in both of his targets for six yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 20-17 Week 2 win over the New York Jets.
items.impact: Lloyd has underwhelmed despite increased touches out of the Green Bay backfield to begin the season, finishing with less than 40 rushing yards in each of the first two games. The running back remains a risky option as part of a running back group leaving a lot to be desired, with a Week 3 contest against the Atlanta Falcons up next.
items.title: MarShawn Lloyd catches touchdown in quiet Week 2 performance

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren rushed for 43 yards on 11 carries in the Steelers' 20-3 loss to the Patriots. He caught 2-of-4 targets for 34 yards.
items.impact: Warren saw the majority of the work after Rico Dowdle was ruled out with a toe injury. If Dowdle is unable to play in Week 3, Warren would be expected to handle the bulk of the work against a Bengals' defense that looked strong in a win over Houston.
items.title: Jaylen Warren tallies 13 touches in Week 2 loss

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Matthew Golden hauled in four of his six targets for a team-high 58 yards in the Packers' 20-17 Week 2 win over the New York Jets.
items.impact: Golden has been one of the few bright spots in an underperforming Packers offense to begin the season, recording four or more receptions for over 50 receiving yards in each of the first two contests. The wideout will look for another impactful performance in a favorable Week 3 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.title: Matthew Golden leads pass-catchers in Week 2 win over Jets

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Steelers QB Aaron Rodgers completed 23-of-39 passes for 187 yards and one interception in the Steelers' 20-3 loss to the Patriots. He added five rushing yards in the loss.
items.impact: Rodgers also fumbled twice in the game, including one that lead to a Patriots' defensive touchdown. The veteran spread the ball around Sunday, completing passes to eight different wide receivers in the loss. Rodgers and the Steelers will face a rebuilt Bengals' defense that looked impressive against Houston in Week 2.
items.title: Aaron Rodgers struggles in Week 2 loss

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Tucker Kraft caught two of his three targets for 15 yards in the Packers' 20-17 Week 2 win over the New York Jets.
items.impact: Kraft was unable to make a significant impact as part of an underwhelming Green Bay passing attack, finishing with less than four receptions in each of the first two games. The tight end will look to get back on track for fantasy managers against the Atlanta Falcons in Week 3.
items.title: Tucker Kraft quiet in Week 2 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: The Patriots D/ST allowed three points, 187 passing yards, and 91 rushing yards in a 20-3 win over the Steelers.
items.impact: The defense tallied four sacks, one interception, and one fumble that resulted in a 19-yard touchdown return by Elijah Ponder. The defense did a great job limiting Rodgers to underneath throws and holding the Steelers' running game to 4.0 yards per carry on 23 attempts. The Patriots' defense will take on the Jaguars on the road in Week 3.
items.title: Patriots D/ST allows three points in Week 2 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Patriots K Andy Borregales connected on 2-of-3 field goals and 2-of-2 extra points in the Patriots' 20-3 win over the Steelers.
items.impact: Borregales connected on field goal attempts from 30 and 45 yards out, while missing from 47-yards out. The second-year kicker should continue to see plenty of field goal opportunities until the passing attack can find consistency.
items.title: Andy Borregales connects on two field goals in Week 2 win

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Chris Brooks rushed four times for 11 yards while also catching one of his two targets for 15 yards in the Packers' 20-17 win over the New York Jets in Week 2.
items.impact: Brooks has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield to begin the season, finishing with less than 30 offensive yards in each of the first two games. The running back is difficult to trust as part of an underwhelming Green Bay backfield to begin the season, with a Week 3 contest against the Atlanta Falcons up next.
items.title: Chris Brooks sees five touches in Week 2

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Patriots TE Eli Raridon caught his lone target for 30 yards in the Patriots' 20-3 win over the Steelers.
items.impact: Rairdon exited the game after the reception and was originally listed as questionable to return. The rookie tight end remained out of the game and fantasy managers will want to monitor his status heading into a Week 3 matchup with Jacksonville.
items.title: Eli Raridon limited in Week 2 due to a thigh injury

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Patriots TE Hunter Henry caught 3-of-5 targets for 40 yards in the Patriots' 20-3 win over the Steelers.
items.impact: Henry led the team in targets and was tied with Romeo Doubs for the team lead in receptions. Henry should continue to see a steady volume with A.J. Brown on injured reserve. The veteran tight end will head to Jacksonville for a Week 3 matchup with the Jaguars.
items.title: Hunter Henry hauls in three passes in Week 2 win

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Kaleb Johnson rushed eight times for 32 yards in the Packers' 20-17 Week 2 win over the New York Jets.
items.impact: Johnson made the most of modest involvement in his first game action of the season, averaging 4.0 yards per carry in the win. The running back could be in line for an increased workload as part of a difficult Green Bay backfield for fantasy managers to trust, with a Week 3 contest against the Atlanta Falcons up next.
items.title: Kaleb Johnson leads ground attack in Week 2 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Patriots WR Mack Hollins caught both of his targets for 18 yards in the Patriots' 20-3 win over the Steelers.
items.impact: Hollins saw his target numbers drop from Week 1, but the passing attack struggled as a whole again. Hollins has a great rapport with QB Drake Maye, which should lead to a potential in increased chances until A.J. Brown returns from injured reserve. Hollins and the Patriots will travel to Jacksonville in Week 3.
items.title: Mack Hollins hauls in two passes in Week 2 win

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Skyy Moore caught two of his three targets for six yards in the Packers' 20-17 win over the New York Jets in Week 2.
items.impact: Moore has struggled to make an impact in the Green Bay passing attack to begin the season, recording three targets or less in each of the first two games. The wideout can remains off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 3 clash with the Atlanta Falcons.
items.title: Skyy Moore catches two passes in Week 2

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Bo Melton failed to catch his only target in the Packers' 20-17 win over the New York Jets in Week 2.
items.impact: Melton saw minimal involvement as part of an underwhelming Green Bay passing attack, finishing last on the team in targets in the win. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 3 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.title: Bo Melton sees one target in Week 2

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Patriots WR DeMario Douglas caught 1-of-2 targets for nine yards in the Patriots' 20-3 win over the Steelers.
items.impact: Douglas saw his target number drop significantly from Week 1, which is a major concern considering A.J. Brown is injured. Douglas is streaming option at best considering the Patriots' passing attack has struggled to open the season.
items.title: DeMario Douglas held to one reception in Week 2

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Patriots WR Romeo Doubs caught 3-of-4 targets for 96 yards in the Patriots' 20-3 win over the Steelers.
items.impact: Doubs had a rough Week 1 but bounced back to lead the Patriots' wide receivers in yardage in Week 2, including an impressive 63-yard reception. With A.J. Brown on injured reserve, Doubs has the opportunity to lead the Patriots' wide receiver room until he returns. Doubs and the Patriots will travel to Jacksonville in Week 3.
items.title: Romeo Doubs rebounds after a tough Week 1
